name: shared-mask
title: One mask preserves row alignment
description: An illustrative table applies the same Boolean row mask to distance, velocity and uncertainty, retaining the same two objects in every column.

name: broadcasting
title: Broadcast one scale per object
description: A feature matrix of shape N by 3 is multiplied by a column of N row scales, producing another N by 3 matrix. Each scale applies across one object's three features.

name: catalogue-selection
title: Filtering and survey selection are separate decisions
description: The 400-row synthetic catalogue loses five invalid rows. Of 395 usable rows, the magnitude cut retains 262 and excludes 133. Histograms compare the usable and selected populations with common bins.

name: git-states
title: A commit records the staged snapshot
description: A first test-file version is staged, then edited again. Without staging the new edit, the next local commit contains the earlier snapshot.

name: git-branches
title: Resolve two descriptions before the merge commit
description: Two branches change the same README paragraph. Their shared history joins in a merge commit after the conflict is resolved to preserve both units and shortest-arc meaning.

name: git-remotes
title: Local commits, remote branches and hosted review
description: Push updates hosted branches; fetch updates local remote-tracking references. A pull request compares hosted branches for review. Fetch alone does not edit the working files.

name: agent-architecture
title: Locate the client, model and tool execution
description: In a laptop Cline session, Qwen inference runs on CPD, while permission-controlled file and terminal tools run with the client. An enforced shell sandbox, when enabled, is a separate boundary.

name: agent-review-loop
title: Keep scientific expectations under human control
description: A student supplies the task and independently justified tests, reviews an agent plan, authorises a bounded implementation change, independently reruns and reviews, then accepts or steers. The agreed tests remain fixed during repair.
